event_summary: In a monochrome mountain landscape, cloud shapes and bright light beams visibly change while the ridgelines remain fixed.
raw_event_description: The video opens on dark mountain silhouettes beneath a layered cloudy sky with bright streaks of light descending through openings in the clouds. Across the sequence, the bright openings along the cloud layer shift in shape and brightness, and the vertical-to-diagonal light beams become more concentrated over the center-right valley area. The dark cloud ceiling covers much of the upper frame throughout, while the lower ridgelines and valley silhouettes stay in the same positions.

reasons: Cloud layers, light beams, and mountain ridgelines are visible from the start.
The lower valley area is dark and partly veiled, limiting surface detail.
The visible process is already underway in the first frame.
